name: Left Stranded
detailed_description:
Left Stranded is a top-down multiplayer factory automation game set in a grounded medieval world. The King has chosen you — a master blacksmith — to tame the wilderness and bring progress to an abandoned land. Your tools are primitive. Your power is limited. But with enough iron and ingenuity, you can build a kingdom of machines.

Start with an axe and a forge. Mine ore, craft tools, and construct machinery powered by waterwheels and oxen. As you fulfill royal contracts, the King will reward you with better technology — steam engines, electric dynamos, and massive production chains.

Build and automate

Build machines powered by treadmills, gear shafts, coal burners, and waterwheels. Start with simple hand-crafted tools and slowly progress to complex factories using conveyor belts, pipes and steam.

Fight and defend

Lay down infrastructure, defend your territory with traps and turrets, and turn wilderness into a heavily fortified estate.

Resource Management

Harvest resources like iron, coal, wood to fuel your machines and defend your land, in a procedurally generated world with dynamic day-night cycles and seasonal changes.

Multiplayer

Left Stranded has been designed with multiplayer in mind from the get-go. Play solo or online with others. Collaborate on massive factories — or fight for control of scarce resources and delivery contracts. You can invite your friends to play together, or if multiplayer is not for you, you can play single player too.

short_description: Left Stranded is a top-down multiplayer automation game where you are a blacksmith, sent by the king to reclaim and industrialize a forgotten land. Build machines, gather resources, and automate production in a multiplayer factory sandbox set in a medieval world powered by water, coal and steam.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 11, 10, 8, 7
  • Processor: Dual core 3Ghz+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10.1 capable GPU with 512 MB VRAM - GeForce GTX 260, Radeon HD 4850 or Intel HD Graphics 5500
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 256 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Normal sprite resolution, Low quality compression, 1080p resolution
